# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/COPILOT_HANDOFF.md` in this repository. Key reminders: no local LLM inference on the host, free-first AI with a privacy gate, tenant and project scoping on every query, read-only bounded model tools, redaction before any LLM call, no secrets in the repository, and no later-milestone stubs presented as finished.
